description: BioShield Space unites Emergency Medicine, Medical Physics, UX, and Full-Stack Engineering to enable clinical autonomy in deep space. Since communication latency prevents real-time telemedicine on Artemis and Mars missions, we are building an adaptive platform that calibrates vitals to microgravity, correlates radiation dosimetry with biomarkers, and guides non-physician astronauts through low-cognitive-load emergency and ultrasound protocols.
